maddeler.e:
استصبحا (form X)
# اِسْتَصْبَحَا (istaṣbaḥā) /is.tasˤ.ba.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# اُسْتُصْبِحَا (ustuṣbiḥā) /us.tusˤ.bi.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# اِسْتَصْبِحَا (istaṣbiḥā) /is.tasˤ.bi.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
